title: Add ghstack CI-status guidance to avoid truncated check-run reads
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #191417

Document that pulling CI for a ghstack PR must not rely on a single
unpaginated check-runs API call: PyTorch PRs have hundreds of check-runs,
so per_page=100 silently truncates and can make a red PR look green. Point
at `gh pr checks <PR> --json ...`, which is head-only and needs no paging.

Test Plan: docs-only change to CLAUDE.md; verified with `git diff`.

Authored with assistance from Claude Code.
